top_signals.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
top_signals.summary: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: The Lag Effect: Trucking Capacity Declines as Rates Recover
top_signals.summary:
Truckload rates rose far faster than costs in 2026, yet carriers keep failing. SONAR data shows why, and what it means for 2027 contract bids.

The post The Lag Effect: Trucking Capacity Declines as Rates Recover appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Excelerate Energy taps Nord Gas for  Reliquefaction Retrofit
top_signals.summary: Nord Gas Solutions (NGS) has been awarded a contract to supply its Compact Reliquefaction System for a floating storage and regasification Unit (FSRU) retrofit project with Excelerate Energy (NYSE: EE). This is the second order Excelerate has placed with NGS for this type of vessel upgrade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
